newsitem.title: USA: Scudder, Stevens names Glavin to run AARP funds.
newsitem.headline: Scudder, Stevens names Glavin to run AARP funds.

text.p: Scudder, Stevens & Clark Inc said Monday that William Glavin is joining the company as general manager of the AARP Investment Program from Scudder, effective April 1.

In this new position, Glavin, said the company, will be responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the AARP Investment Program from Scudder, a family of 15 no-load mutual funds and specialized services for investors planning for and living in retirement.

Glavin comes to Scudder from Dreyfus Corp, a unit of Mellon Bank Corp, where he was executive vice president of market and product development and a member of the company's senior management committee.
Scudder, a global investment management fund, provides mutual funds to the 30 million members of the American Association of Retired Persons.
